# MarigoApp

> MarigoApp is a curated online marketplace for authenticated pre-owned luxury
> fashion. Buyers discover designer bags, shoes, clothing and accessories;
> sellers list items with AI-assisted pricing and descriptions. The company is
> based in Tirana, Albania and ships across Albania, Italy and the wider EU.

Canonical site: https://www.marigoapp.com

## What MarigoApp does

- **Buy** authenticated pre-owned luxury fashion from vetted sellers. Every
  order is held in escrow: the buyer's card is authorised at checkout and funds
  are released to the seller only after delivery plus a hold window.
- **Sell** in a guided six-step listing flow, with optional AI assistance that
  drafts the title, description, category and a suggested price from photos.
- **Deliver** through Marigo's own courier network. Delivery is a flat 200 ALL
  fee paid by the buyer at checkout.

## Key facts

- Currencies: prices are settled in EUR; displayed in ALL (default), EUR or USD.
- Primary market: Albania. Also serves Italy and the EU.
- Languages: English and Albanian.
- Categories: Clothing, Bags, Shoes, Accessories, Active Wear,
  Jewellery & Watches, kidswear, Beauty, Home and Art.
- Condition grades: New with tag, New without tag, Very good condition,
  Good condition.
- Buyer protection: escrow payments, a refund window, and a returns and
  disputes process handled by Marigo support.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.marigoapp.com/): featured, new and discounted listings.
- [Browse](https://www.marigoapp.com/browse): category, brand and price navigation.
- [Search](https://www.marigoapp.com/search): full catalogue search and filters
  for brand, size, colour, material, condition and price.
- [About](https://www.marigoapp.com/about): who Marigo is and how it works.
- [Help](https://www.marigoapp.com/help): buying, selling, delivery, returns and payments.
- [Become a delivery partner](https://www.marigoapp.com/delivery-partner): courier recruitment.
- [Terms of Service](https://www.marigoapp.com/terms)
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.marigoapp.com/privacy)

## For crawlers

- Listings sitemap: https://www.marigoapp.com/server-sitemap.xml
- Site sitemap: https://www.marigoapp.com/sitemap.xml
- Individual listings live at https://www.marigoapp.com/products/{id} and carry
  schema.org Product, Offer, AggregateRating and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.
